disclosure: This evaluation uses synthetic transcripts with provisional labels supplied by the same project assistant that authored the cases and had prior access to the CallGate implementation. Labels were not derived from CallGate predictions. No independent human annotation, adjudication, or inter-rater reliability study has been completed. A frozen holdout limits later tuning exposure but does not establish author independence or real-world validity.

turns.text: Your payment may be delayed unless we update some details.
Which details?
Let me pull up the form.
This is the fraud desk. Did you make a large purchase this morning?
I do not recognize your number.
Please confirm whether the purchase was yours.
Please stop the scheduled transfer immediately.
You called the number printed on your bank card; which scheduled payment?
The rent payment I created yesterday. Cancel it, do not send money elsewhere.
Your card is ready at the branch.
I requested that replacement yesterday.
Bring identification to the branch; do not share any code on this call.
Please read the login code; I will reverse the fraud.
The message says bank staff never ask for it.
Ignore that message, it is only for ordinary customers.
I am your bank's dispute officer. Install this app so I can watch your banking screen.
My bank's dispute team just confirmed they did not call.
They are not allowed to know about my investigation.
I work for an agency contractor arranging inspections.
Was this visit requested by my landlord?
I cannot see who booked it.
There is an outstanding administrative fee.
How much and where can I verify it?
I will have another officer call you.
We must reschedule your jury service appointment urgently.
I called the courthouse switchboard and was transferred here.
Please choose another date; no payment is involved.
I need to pay my permit fee before construction starts.
Use the official portal listed on the permit application you already have.
I see the matching invoice and will pay there.
Please take your time providing your benefits login code.
The code says never share it, even with agency employees.
Our hidden verification procedure requires you to read it out.
A warrant disappears if you send cryptocurrency to my personal wallet.
Can my lawyer contact the court?
No lawyers or court staff may hear about this payment.
My account is frozen; could you cover dinner and I will repay you?
When will it be unfrozen?
I am waiting to hear.
Please keep my medical problem private and help with the bill.
Can I pay the clinic directly?
Let me check with them.
I am upset that you forgot our rent. Please pay your share tonight.
The lease and shared bill show the same landlord account as last month.
Yes, use that saved payee and send me the receipt.
My train was cancelled; can you buy me another ticket urgently?
I can book directly with the rail company using the itinerary we already share.
That works; no cash transfer needed.
I love you, but my travel visa needs a gift-card payment.
The consulate says it never accepts gift cards.
They hide this special process; trust me instead.
We can build a future together through my guaranteed investment.
Can I withdraw first?
You must pay an extra release fee to my private wallet before any withdrawal.
I can help recover the files you lost.
How did you get my number?
It came with the support request.
A technician needs administrator access.
Is this part of our maintenance window?
I do not have the schedule in front of me.
My password reset is urgent before my shift.
Use the reset link on your company sign-in page; do not tell me the code.
I completed it privately and can log in.
Please share your screen for the bug we scheduled.
I have closed my email and banking tabs and can stop sharing anytime.
Show only the application error, not your desktop.
I detected viruses on your computer from our global scan; buy gift cards to remove them.
You have no access to my computer.
Our scan reaches every computer, even offline ones.
Disable your security tools so I can repair the machine.
Our IT desk says you are not one of their technicians.
Do not contact them again; only I can fix this.
